note: Case geography for the map view (GridSim reads case-level geography.json from 2.1.003).

projection.formula: x = m + (1-2m)*(lon-west)/(east-west); y = m + (1-2m)*(lat-south)/(north-south); clamped to [0,1]; north is y=1 (drawn at 1-y on screen)
projection.note: east box S 34.4, W 137.3, N 41.7, E 142.2 (regions.json 'japan-spine' east), margin 0.03: the Tohoku and Tokyo areas' prefectures with padding; Hokkaido and the Izu / Ogasawara islands fall outside and are clipped
